errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis ("Left bias", "Left center bias", "Quest. source", "Right bias") are not arranged alphabetically. For example, 'Quest. source' comes after 'Left center bias' but Q comes after L in the alphabet.

The description repeatedly uses the phrase "reaches approximately [value]" to describe the size of individual segments within a stacked bar. This is ambiguous because "reaches" typically refers to a point on an axis, not the length or size of a segment. For example, for "Left bias", the top of the "VICTIM" segment reaches approximately 0.47 on the y-axis, but the description says it "reaches approximately 0.15", which is its proportional size, not its position.
